name: mdx-message-replay-contract
human_line: A reconnect never pretends to be live. The relay replays what it provably holds and names the verdict; anything it cannot prove, the client fills from the saved record first.

ready.replay_window_meaning: hot cache entries per topic - the relay's provable reach

subscribe.cursor_ownership: client-owned, advanced only by envelopes actually received
subscribe.device_id: names the browser across reconnects for operators - observability, never identity
subscribe.backward_compatibility: device_id and connection_generation are optional; an older client subscribes exactly as before

catch_up.caught_up: the replay provably covered the client's cursor to now
catch_up.gap_detected: the cursor is before the cache's reach - evictions may hide messages; fill from the projection
catch_up.snapshot_required: the cache is empty and the cursor is real - the relay cannot know what was missed; full projection reload
catch_up.client_behavior: live only after every topic's verdict is caught_up or its gap is filled; the surface shows catching up in between, never a false live dot

gap_fill.source: the kernel projection - the saved record is the truth the cache could not cover
gap_fill.duplicate_safety: timeline rebuilds from the projection wholesale and live envelopes dedupe by receipt_id and message_id

proof: with a hot cache smaller than the outage, disconnect, land more messages than the cache holds, reconnect: the relay answers gap_detected, the surface says catching up, the projection fill recovers every message exactly once
